name: bentcrypto-mcp
description: Local MCP bridge for BentCrypto token-risk and token-security x402 APIs.
long_description: BentCrypto MCP gives MCP-compatible agents free discovery and x402 payment-preview tools plus opt-in paid Token Risk and Token Security calls. Token Risk supports Solana and Base. Token Security supports Solana only. Payments are disabled by default, payer signing stays local, and the bridge enforces a configurable per-call USDC cap before signing.

tools.name: discover_bentcrypto
tools.description: Discover live BentCrypto products, supported chains, pricing, and API metadata without making a payment.

tools.name: preview_token_risk_payment
tools.description: Inspect the live x402 token-risk payment requirement without signing or paying.

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Run the paid BentCrypto Token Risk analysis on Solana or Base after explicit local payment opt-in.

tools.name: token_security
tools.description: Run the paid BentCrypto Token Security analysis on Solana after explicit local payment opt-in.

allow_payments.title: Enable x402 payments
allow_payments.description: Leave NO for discovery-only use. Set to YES only after reviewing the local wallet and $0.01 default per-call spend policy.

max_usdc_per_call.title: Maximum USDC per call
max_usdc_per_call.description: Local maximum payment amount allowed for one MCP call.

preferred_payment_network.title: Preferred payment network
preferred_payment_network.description: Optional preferred x402 network, for example eip155:8453 for Base. Leave blank to let the bridge choose a supported requirement.

evm_private_key.title: Base payment wallet private key
evm_private_key.description: Optional dedicated low-balance Base wallet key. Never required for discovery-only use.

svm_private_key.title: Solana payment wallet private key
svm_private_key.description: Optional dedicated low-balance Solana wallet key. Never required for discovery-only use.
